cadmpeg dialect identity and capability registries

The cadmpeg-registry 0.6.12 package embeds the following catalog files from the
cadmpeg project without changes:

https://github.com/cadmpeg/cadmpeg/blob/9d7592c64b11bd8dcdac7794087f050506619b75/crates/cadmpeg-registry/docs/dialect-support.toml
